name: funnel-draw
description: Plan, draw and forecast marketing funnels on the Funnel Draw canvas, then compare the plan with real ad and sales numbers.

interface.longDescription:
Funnel Draw turns a conversation about a business into a marketing funnel you can see, forecast and improve.

Tell ChatGPT what you sell, your prices, your market and your monthly ad budget. It asks the questions that decide the plan, then shows three funnels side by side, drawn on the real Funnel Draw canvas: a smaller one, the one that fits your budget, and a bigger one, each with its channels, its steps and what it needs a month. Pick one and it is drawn in your Funnel Draw workspace with its stages, typical conversion rates, costs and prices, a strategy and a launch checklist.

From there you can ask:
- Where does this funnel lose the most money, and what should I fix first?
- What if the landing page converted at 6% instead of 4%?
- What does it take to make 10,000 a month in profit?
- How do my real Google Ads, Meta Ads, Snapchat Ads and TikTok Ads numbers compare with the plan? (when the ad accounts are connected in Funnel Draw)
- Write me a report I can share with my team.

Every forecast comes from Funnel Draw's own engine: people, customers, revenue, ad spend, profit, ROAS and cost per customer, step by step. Real numbers always name their source and dates.

Who it is for: founders, marketers, coaches, course creators, e-commerce stores, SaaS teams and agencies who plan paid traffic and want to know if a funnel pays before spending on it.

What you need: a Funnel Draw account. ChatGPT works only inside the workspace you choose when you connect, and changes funnels only if you allow it. Deleting a funnel always needs its exact name.

Limits: Funnel Draw plans and measures funnels; it does not run ads, build web pages, send emails or take payments.
capabilities: Plan a marketing funnel by asking about the business first
Show three funnels to choose from, drawn on the canvas
Draw the chosen funnel with stages, rates, costs and prices
Forecast customers, revenue, profit and ROAS
Rank what to fix first and test what-ifs
Compare the plan with real ad and sales numbers
defaultPrompt: Plan a funnel for my online course: it costs $497 and I have $2,000 a month for ads.
Where does my funnel lose the most money, and what should I fix first?
What if my landing page converted at 6% instead of 4%?

positive.prompt: What funnels do I have in Funnel Draw, and which one is forecast to make the most profit?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the three sample funnels with their canvas links and compares their forecast profit, naming the most profitable one.

positive.description: Find where a funnel loses money
positive.prompt: Where does my Spring webinar funnel lose the most money, and what should I fix first?
positive.expected_behavior: Ranks the links and prices to improve by the profit each adds, biggest first, using the funnel's own forecast, and ends with the canvas link.

positive.description: Plan a new funnel by asking first, then propose three
positive.prompt: Plan a funnel for my coaching business. I sell an 8-week program for $997 to new managers in the US and I have $3,000 a month for ads.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks the few missing questions in one message, then shows three funnels (smaller, recommended, bigger) with their channels and monthly cost; nothing is drawn until the reviewer picks one.

positive.prompt: In my Spring webinar funnel, what if 35% of registrants showed up instead of today's rate?
positive.expected_behavior: Compares the forecast before and after the change (customers, revenue, profit) and says nothing was saved.

positive.prompt: Write a report on my high-ticket coaching funnel that I can share with my team.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a Markdown report with the forecast totals, a per-step table, the top fixes with the profit each adds, and the canvas link.

negative.prompt: Send $500 from my Funnel Draw account to my Meta ad account.
Make a video ad for my webinar and post it on Instagram.

negative.description: Another company's data is out of reach
negative.prompt: Show me the funnels of another company's Funnel Draw workspace.

review.commerce_description: Funnel Draw does not sell or take payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: plan funnels by interview, three options drawn in the chat, forecasts, what-ifs, leak analysis, real ad and sales numbers beside the plan, and shareable reports.
